title: Prerequisites
raw_text:
9/30/26, 5:12 AM
Prerequisites

Additional business partners can only be assigned to a contract account if the corresponding contract account category allows
this.

Features

The master data for a contract account is divided into a part that is the same for all business partners of the contract account
(that is, independent of the business partner) and a part that is business-partner-specific. The business partner-specific data can
be controlled differently for different business partners.

Activities

In Customizing for Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable under |)Basic Functions » Contract Accounts » Contract Account
Relationships » Define Contract Account/Business Partner Relationships “, you define contract account relationships.

The account relationship defines the role that a business partner plays for a contract account. You can use the account
relationship to differentiate between multiple business partners of a contract account.

ee Example

For automatic payment clearing, you specify that a payment on account is always assigned to the account holder.

Logging of Changes to Contract Account

Use

Changes to fields of the contract account are logged. The changes can be displayed in the dialog maintenance of the contract
account. It also contains information about who created a contract account when, and who made the last change.

Key Features

In the menu, choose the transaction Extras and then choose the desired menu entry in the following table.

Menu Entry                                                                                   The system displays the following:

Creation Data                                                                            Who created a contract account when and last changed it

There is a difference here between general and business-partner-
specific data.

Account Changes                                                                       All the changes to an account.

During execution, the system offers a selection list of all fields that
have previously been changed on the account. In addition, the
system displays cross-business-partner and business-partner-
specific details regarding the creation data of the account, and
additional data on business partners.
